items.defectStatement: The getBaseConditions test's result assertion cannot distinguish the intended authorization-and-filter intersection from either condition alone. Its user booking satisfies both predicates, so dropping either predicate still passes.
obligations: Fail if getBaseConditions returns only the authorization predicate.
Fail if getBaseConditions returns only the filter predicate.
Verify AND composition while retaining the successful matching-booking assertion.
items.notes: A structural composition assertion fixes this locally without changing fixtures. A behavioral alternative should include both auth-only and filter-only rows; adding only the suggested filter-only row cannot detect dropping the filter predicate.

items.defectStatement: The constructor's public options type permits team scope without teamId, although the runtime schema requires it. Such calls compile but fail validation and silently produce empty insights.
obligations: Reject team-scoped options missing teamId at compile time, or explicitly report their runtime validation failure.
Continue accepting valid team options and user/org options without teamId.
Preserve authorization checks and prevent malformed options from granting access.
items.notes: Changing only the constructor parameter to InsightsBookingServiceOptions also works. Explicit runtime rejection is an alternative allowed by the finding, but changes existing invalid-input behavior.

items.defectStatement: When no filter is present, getBaseConditions returns a team/org authorization OR expression without enclosing parentheses. Appending AND extra therefore applies extra only to the last OR branch, allowing earlier branches to bypass the extra restriction; this does not itself bypass the base authorization predicate.
obligations: Ensure an appended AND predicate applies to every branch of the returned condition.
Preserve the intersection of authorization and filters when both exist.
Preserve parameterized SQL and deny-all behavior.
items.notes: Wrapping at this boundary suffices; changing the eventTypeId fragment elsewhere is unnecessary. The both-present branch already groups its operands correctly for appended AND. No production caller using the hazardous composition was found.
